title: The TI WooCommerce Wishlist WordPress plugin before 2.13.0 does not verify that a visitor who is not logged in owns a…
description: The TI WooCommerce Wishlist WordPress plugin versions prior to 2.13.0 contain a vulnerability where unauthenticated visitors can manage wishlists belonging to other users if they know or guess the wishlist's share key. This allows unauthorized deletion of items from other customers' wishlists.
